turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: hi, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I have a promo code but I don't know when it is active.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: huh, let's see what we can find out

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: can I have your name please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was hoping to use it today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Crystal Minh

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: usually the codes are good for 7 days

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, so I should use it soon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: let me check

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: did you try to use it already?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I wasn't sure if it was active yet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: you have had it for less than 7 days?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I just got it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: hold on let me check something else for you

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Searching the FAQ pages ...

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: System Action: search timing

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: FAQ answer related to timing (question4) was selected.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should be able to see the expiration date - tiny font on the bottom of the page

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I see it! I didn't scroll down far enough.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Generally they expire after 7 days

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: sure. is there anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was it. Thanks again!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: have a great day!
